entries.name: Ring all 8 hidden bells
entries.how: Each bell clears the map fog around it. Do these first: they make every other collectible easier to find.

sources.t: PowerPyx: all Sealed Abyss Artifact locations

entries.name: Sealed Abyss Artifacts: Hernand
entries.how: Not marked on the map. They sit along roads and in small roadside shrines and show as purple icons on the minimap when you're close. Guiding Light (CTRL + Left Click) makes a blue glimmer near one. 141 in the game across all regions.
